references.text: Parallel account in Judges describing the same event where Achsah comes to Othniel and persuades him to ask her father for a piece of land.
Continuation of the parallel narrative in Judges where Achsah asks her father Caleb for water springs, just as in the Joshua text.
The immediate context where Caleb promises his daughter Achsah to whoever captures Kiriath-sepher, and Othniel wins her.
Continuation where Achsah asks for water springs and Caleb gives her both the upper and lower springs.
Background on Caleb's inheritance and his faithfulness, explaining why he had land to give to his daughter.
